name: The Metal Knight
old_description: At The Metal Knight, we are dedicated to providing high-quality metal fabrication, repair, and welding services to businesses and individuals throughout the Treasure Valley. With years of experience in the industry and a commitment to excellence, we have earned a reputation as a trusted and reliable partner for all your metalworking needs.
about:
The Metal Knight operates from a residential address on South Lindsay Avenue in Boise, Idaho, serving businesses and individuals throughout the Treasure Valley. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names, describing only "years of experience" in metal fabrication, repair, and welding services.

The shop provides in‑shop welding using MIG, TIG, and Stick processes, metal repair for damaged machinery, tools, and equipment, and custom metal fabrication that spans single prototypes to larger production runs. Its CNC and laser machining equipment works with steel and copper to produce precise components. No facility square footage, employee count, or annual volume figures are published.

The company lists construction, automotive, and customized commissions among the industries it serves. Because the facility sits in a residential neighborhood, the firm requires appointments for all visits.

The Metal Knight cites experienced and skilled professionals, a commitment to quality and reliability, and competitive pricing paired with exceptional service as the factors that set it apart.
built_on: Appointment-based access due to residential location
